semantic_recovery.reason: Legacy prediction rows were originally hashed from Python float values before PostgreSQL NUMERIC(38,18) storage and compact one-second market-state rows can be overwritten by later same-bucket events.
semantic_recovery.accepted_verifier_contract: Use the existing exact stored-value/legacy alias checks first. For remaining legacy prediction failures, reconstruct candidate live inputs from frozen Phase 9 policy provenance and immutable recorder raw events up to the stored cutoff, require exact stored input_fingerprint equality, rebuild the complete LivePrediction through the production writer, and accept only exact stored semantic_sha256 equality.

research_interpretation.phase_10_result: Prospective, immutable, pre-outcome live prediction infrastructure is accepted for the verified 5m and 15m horizons under the money-disabled research boundary.
research_interpretation.evaluation_interpretation: No official-outcome evaluations were available during the bounded acceptance run; evaluation_status=pending is valid and does not weaken the pre-outcome acceptance proof.
research_interpretation.phase_11_direction: Build Dashboard V1 so active markets, model probabilities, market prices, edge/action, feed health, prediction history, accuracy/calibration, paper P&L when later available, and current mode can be understood without opening the database.
